mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW ( RATING, CONTENT, REVIEW_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, USER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ITEM_ID, TITLE ) VALUES ( #{rating}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW(), #{userId}, #{productId}, #{itemId}, #{title} )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.RATING AS rating, R.CONTENT AS content, R.REVIEW_STATUS AS reviewStatus, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(R.UPDATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS updatedAt, R.USER_ID AS userId, R.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, R.ITEM_ID AS itemId, R.TITLE AS title, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, ( SELECT RI.IMG_URL FROM REVIEW_IMG RI WHERE RI.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID ORDER BY RI.IMG_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC LIMIT ${pageSize} OFFSET ${offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.RATING AS rating, R.CONTENT AS content, R.REVIEW_STATUS AS reviewStatus, DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(R.UPDATED_AT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS updatedAt, R.USER_ID AS userId, R.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, R.ITEM_ID AS itemId, R.TITLE AS title, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, ( SELECT RI.IMG_URL FROM REVIEW_IMG RI WHERE RI.REVIEW_ID = R.REVIEW_ID ORDER BY RI.IMG_ID ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE R.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND R.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET TITLE = #{title}, RATING = #{rating}, CONTENT = #{content}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMG_ID, REVIEW_ID, IMG_URL AS imgUrl FROM REVIEW_IMG WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} ORDER BY IMG_ID ASC
